programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc:
A series of reports presenting the customs and life situation of women living in distant corners of the globe.Journalist Martyna Wojciechowska once again sets out on risky expeditions to learn about the activities, passions and dreams of women living in different cultures.Stops in the third edition of the program include Samoa, Ghana and India.Together with her interlocutors, she experiences their joys and sorrows and participates in everyday activities.This allows her to understand contrasts and learn about different approaches to femininity in different parts of the world
While traveling around Australia, Martyna Wojciechowska meets Heather, who 9 years ago was an average single mother working in an office.Her life was changed by a meeting with extreme sports psychologist Glenn Singleman.Today, Heather jumps with a parachute, climbs and dives.She holds world records and is the author of a book about overcoming fears.In front of the traveler's eyes, Heather will jump from a plane wearing a suit that delays free fall.The heroine of the episode will also tell an unusual love story.

In the wastelands of Ghana, far from the settlements, there live women sentenced to banishment for crimes committed using witchcraft.Ich winę potwierdził prosty rytuał.Martyna Wojciechowska reaches one of the camps of women considered witches.They suffer from the loss of contact with their family and the rejection they experience because someone suspected them of dabbling in black magic.Among them are Amina and her granddaughter Rukaye, who after many years, thanks to the program's crew, get a chance to meet their loved ones.

programs.title: Men, Women, Wild
programs.desc: Three couples, husband and wife, mother and father, and a boy and a girl, set off on an extreme expedition.For three weeks they try to survive in the most dangerous places on the planet.

programs.title: Marooned with Ed Stafford 2
programs.desc: Former British Army captain and experienced traveler Ed Stafford continues to overcome new challenges.He became known to viewers as a steadfast man who is able to cope with any extreme situation.So far, among others:he underwent a test of survival for 60 days on one of the uninhabited islands of Fiji, where he had no supplies of food, clothing or necessary equipment.Moreover, he walked the trail leading along the Amazon River, which earned him a place in history and the Guinness Book of Records.In the next series of the program "Ed Stafford Beyond Civilization", the traveler once again sets off to the most hostile corners of the world, including the Gobi Desert in Mongolia and the crocodile-infested Guatemalan jungle.

programs.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programs.desc: Boston is a city of great historical and scientific importance.This is where prestigious universities such as Harvard and MIT are located, as well as the headquarters of Boston Dynamics, known for creating humanoid robots.Although the city is associated with the American Revolution, it also has lesser-known stories.Marcin will meet a guide who will talk about the first settlers and explain events such as the flooding of the city by molasses in the early 20th century, the smell of which can still be felt on hot days.Marcin will also talk to Walter Robinson from the Boston Globe about the famous journalistic investigation presented in the film "Spotlight", which revealed a scandal in the local archdiocese, affecting the city and the world.In addition, the host will take viewers to Salem, a town known for its witch trials from three hundred years ago.Today, the Salem witches attract tourists and are one of the area's main attractions.
